crossRefs.note: David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.
Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will…
the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
Three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam; and the troop of…
David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines…
I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy.
For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
I will yet bring to you, inhabitant of Mareshah. He who is the glory of Israel will come to Adullam.
of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

people.name: Adullam
people.line: A Canaanite city, later fortified by Judah.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: David therefore departed from there, and escaped to Adullam’s cave. When his brothers and all his father’s house heard it, they went down there to him.
translations.bsb: So David left Gath and took refuge in the cave of Adullam. When his brothers and the rest of his father’s household heard about it, they went down to him there.
translations.kjv: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father's house heard it, they went down thither to him.
translations.asv: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave of Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father's house heard it, they went down thither to him.
